ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Profile.Name<>'Automated Process' && $Profile.Name<>'System Administrator' && $Profile.Name<>'Global Delegated Admin' && (ISBLANK( Contract_Duration__c ) || Contract_Duration__c < 12) && (ISPICKVAL( Type__c, 'Win') || ISPICKVAL( Type__c, 'Upsell') || ISPICKVAL( Type__c, 'Downsell') || ISPICKVAL( Type__c, 'Upward renewal') || ISPICKVAL( Type__c, 'Downward renewal'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please add a contract duration greater than or equal to 12 months for win or upsell or downsell
